iphone-6.9.notes: Required tier. Capture on iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator.

iphone-6.5.notes: Optional; App Store auto-scales 6.9 if omitted. Same template, smaller canvas.

ipad-13.notes: Required when the app ships on iPad. Dual-pane screens are the point.

android-phone.notes: Raw emulator captures (1080x2400) exceed Play's 2:1 rule; always compose onto this canvas. 9:16 at 1080 is the featuring bar. JPEG/PNG-24, no alpha, 8MB.

android-tablet-landscape.notes: 10-inch slot. Landscape layout: text zone left, device right.

play-feature-graphic.notes: Required for featuring consideration. Type + field only, no screenshot.
